claim_profiles.definition: Canonical config, native filetype/root envelope, settings schema, and manual setup projection.

Every node/proposition terminally implemented/proven, transferred/superseded, explicitly limited with owner, or blocked on a named external stage; optional cells may legitimately end limited instead of passing.
Exact version/platform, public-install, upstream directory/package, progressive support, and generated documentation stages.
Core plus applicable atomic sync/desync, parser-input/artifact/strategy, and asynchronous-open/race/ABA/retention propositions composed only by the complete-deep fan-in.
Consumes exactly one #8129 branch (selected_value=full_document_utf16) and only the Neovim cells required by the selected bounded public claim; parser-work and race propositions are never required.
Exact actual-host attach/root, target diagnostics, completion, hover/navigation, safe settings effect, actual edit/current re-query, formatting application/idempotence, and graceful cleanup.
